interface.shortDescription: Charter coaches and private cars in Vietnam
interface.longDescription: Connects to the public, read-only OlaChill Vietnam MCP server (https://olachillvietnam.com/mcp). Lists published charter coach classes and private car and limousine types in Vietnam with passenger and luggage guidance, and explains how to request a quote. It never books, and it gives no live availability or confirmed prices.
